bio: I received my Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Transportation Engineering) from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in September 2026, advised by Dr. Chengbo Ai.

My dissertation, Quality-Aware Multi-LiDAR Framework for Traffic Perception and Safety Analysis, connects background modeling, unsupervised 3D detection, multi-object tracking, and quality-aware traffic conflict analysis. I am extending this work toward infrastructure-centric world models (I-WM), multi-sensor calibration reliability, and spatial intelligence.
A complementary research direction studies transportation system optimization under uncertainty, including EV routing and charging, charging queues, and roadway asset management.

Before UMass Amherst, I earned my M.S. and B.S. degrees at Chang’an University, where my master’s research was advised by Dr. Qiang Bai. My earlier work focused on pavement maintenance optimization and deep learning-based airport curbside vehicle detection.

bio: 我于 2026 年 9 月获得麻省大学阿默斯特分校 (UMass Amherst) 土木工程（交通运输工程方向）博士学位，导师为 Chengbo Ai 副教授。
博士论文 面向交通感知与安全分析的质量感知多激光雷达框架围绕路侧多激光雷达感知，连接背景建模、无监督三维目标检测、多目标跟踪与质量感知交通冲突分析，并进一步拓展至基础设施中心世界模型（I-WM）、多传感器标定可靠性与空间智能。
另一条研究主线聚焦不确定性条件下的交通系统优化，包括电动汽车路径与充电调度、充电排队和道路资产养护决策。
在赴美攻读博士之前，我在长安大学获得工学硕士和工学学士学位，硕士导师为柏强教授。此前的研究聚焦于路面养护优化及基于深度学习的机场路侧车辆检测。
